# 74H54 - Expandable 2-2-2-3-input AND-OR-INVERT gates

Package DIP-14 · family 74H · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74H54.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74H54.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 14 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74H54 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74H54.png) | ![74H54 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74H54.png) | ![74H54 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74H54.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Y = NOT ((A AND B) OR (C AND D) OR (E AND F AND G) OR (H AND I)) | Y is low when AB, or CD, or EFG, or HI are all high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 25 pF, RL 280 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 7 | 11 |
| any | Y | PHL | 6.2 | 11 |

## Notes

The 1976 TI book draws pins 11 and 12 under 'make no external connection' and gives the 74H54 (J, N) no expander pins, so the 'expandable' in the ND title is not borne out by this datasheet. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
